description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named ProfesorController that manages HTTP requests related to 'Profesor' entities, including CRUD operations and linking 'Profesor' with 'Curso' entities within a web application.

classes.name: ProfesorController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling HTTP requests for managing 'Profesor' entities, including create, read, update, delete, and detail view functionalities.

methods.name: addProfesor
methods.description: Handles GET requests to add a new profesor, initializes the form model.

methods.name: saveProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new profesor, delegating creation to the service layer.

methods.name: getProfesorForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a profesor by ID for editing.

methods.name: updateProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing profesor's details.

methods.name: patchProfesor
methods.description: Handles PATCH-like POST requests to partially update a profesor's details.

methods.name: getProfesoresList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all profesores.

methods.name: deleteProfesor
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a profesor by ID.

methods.name: getProfesorDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve detailed information about a specific profesor, including their cursos.
